context:
Evaluating a Coralogix support response for this user question:

A self-managed collector-contrib deployment runs v0.151.0 and is not sure whether the spanmetrics collector.instance.id dimension is emitted. Which feature gate and version behavior should we verify?

checklist.name: for-self-managed-collector-contrib-v0-136-0-t
checklist.description: For self-managed collector-contrib v0.136.0 through v0.151.x, tells the user to start the collector with --feature-gates=+connector.spanmetrics.includeCollectorInstanceID or otherwise preserve a writer-unique dimension. It must also explain that v0.152.0+ promotes the gate to beta / enabled by default, while noting that collector.instance.id can still be disabled or removed and should be verified in generated metrics. PASS if it names the gate, the v0.136.0-v0.151.x behavior, and the v0.152.0+ behavior. FAIL if it omits the v0.152.0+ behavior or treats collector.instance.id as guaranteed in v0.151.0 without the feature gate.
